old_caption: The video begins with a static shot of a series of colorful blocks arranged in ascending height against a plain white wall. The blocks are stacked on a wooden floor, and their colors include yellow, pink, blue, and purple. Each block is connected to the next by a gray base, forming a continuous line. As the video progresses, the blocks start to fall one by one from right to left, creating a domino effect. The first block to fall is the tallest, followed by the others in descending order. The falling blocks cause a cascade of smaller blocks to tumble down, forming a pile at the base of the initial stack. The sequence continues until all the blocks have fallen, leaving only the gray bases visible on the floor. The background remains unchanged throughout the video, maintaining a simple and clean setting. There are no characters or animals present in the scene, and the focus remains solely on the falling blocks and their interaction with each other.

caption: Against a plain light wall with a white baseboard and pale wooden floor, a row of tall flat domino towers stands balanced on edge, colored teal, yellow, pink, teal, yellow, pink, teal from the middle rightward. Loose multicolored pieces lie heaped to their left, and a long line of small gray dominoes runs along the right edge. The leftmost pink tower is already leaning leftward toward the loose pile. It rotates further over its fall, its top striking the pile before the tower collapses into the heap. Blurred fragments kick outward to the left as it settles. The adjacent teal tower then tilts left, leaning progressively until its upper end drops onto the pile and scatters more pieces. The next yellow tower begins to lean in the same direction, still standing at a slant. The towers to its right and the gray domino line remain untouched throughout. The wall and floor stay fixed, with motion blur marking each fast collapse.
